## ParaAPI.getCustomProperties() method

Return all `--para-*` CSS custom properties found in the page's stylesheets, as a flat dot-path map (e.g. `{ 'chart.type': 'line', 'type.line.lineWidth': 5 }`). Useful for debugging and verifying which CSS properties are being picked up.

**Signature:**

```typescript
getCustomProperties(): SettingsInput;
```
**Returns:**

[SettingsInput](./paracharts.settingsinput.md)
